mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, o.order_status, o.payment_status, o.total_amount, o.freight_amount, o.pay_amount, o.remark, o.paid_at, o.shipped_at, o.completed_at, o.created_at, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_province, o.receiver_city, o.receiver_district, o.receiver_address, oi.product_id AS item_product_id, oi.product_name AS item_product_name, oi.sku_id AS item_sku_id, oi.sku_specs AS item_sku_specs, oi.sku_image AS item_sku_image, oi.price AS item_price, oi.quantity AS item_quantity, oi.total_amount AS item_total_amount, p.payment_no, p.pay_type, p.pay_status, p.paid_at AS payment_paid_at FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id AND p.pay_status = 1 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT o.order_no, o.order_status, o.payment_status, o.total_amount, o.freight_amount, o.pay_amount, o.remark, o.paid_at, o.shipped_at, o.completed_at, o.created_at, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_province, o.receiver_city, o.receiver_district, o.receiver_address, oi.product_id AS item_product_id, oi.product_name AS item_product_name, oi.sku_id AS item_sku_id, oi.sku_specs AS item_sku_specs, oi.sku_image AS item_sku_image, oi.price AS item_price, oi.quantity AS item_quantity, oi.total_amount AS item_total_amount, p.payment_no, p.pay_type, p.pay_status, p.paid_at AS payment_paid_at FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id = o.id AND p.pay_status = 1 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET order_status = 1, payment_status = 1, paid_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND order_status = 0
UPDATE `order` SET order_status = 4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND order_status = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE `order` SET order_status = 5, payment_status = 2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND order_status IN (1, 2)
UPDATE `order` SET order_status = 4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND order_status = 0 AND deleted = 0
